evidence.notes: Global describe returns SObjectType tokens keyed by local object API name.
describeSObjects accepts local object API names.
SObjectType tokens expose local object describe metadata.

source.content: @isTest private class SchemaGlobalDescribeTokensFixtureTest { @isTest static void globalDescribeReturnsTokens() { Map<String,Schema.SObjectType> describes = Schema.getGlobalDescribe(); System.assert(describes.containsKey('Account')); Schema.SObjectType accountType = describes.get('Account'); Schema.DescribeSObjectResult accountDescribe = accountType.getDescribe(); System.assertEquals('Account', accountDescribe.getName()); System.assertEquals('Accounts', accountDescribe.getLabelPlural()); List<Schema.DescribeSObjectResult> byName = Schema.describeSObjects(new List<String>{'Account'}); System.assertEquals('Account', byName.get(0).getName()); } }
